audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp is described as shredding armour and healing him off every auto, in whys[0], spikes[0] and early. The early text also names a 'Contaminate zone'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Chomp is damage, a brief slow, and sapping the target's Attack Damage, with an auto-attack reset, on 3.5s — no armour shred and no heal. His healing comes from King's Tribute (P) when units die near him, amplified while standing in Frozen Domain (W). Contaminate is not in this kit at all.
audit.corrected: Chomp restated as an AD sap plus slow and auto reset with its 3.5s cooldown; healing attributed to King's Tribute and the Frozen Domain amp; Contaminate removed.
sources: Trundle kit Q text, cd 3.5, 'autoReset' flag
Trundle kit P and W text

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Blood Hunt lifesteal' appears in spikes[2] and late, and Pillar of Ice is described only as a slow that kites you.
audit.why: Blood Hunt grants move and attack speed against targets under 50% health and heals nothing — the healing is Eternal Hunger. Pillar of Ice creates impassable terrain, which can block Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress outright, not merely slow them.
audit.corrected: Healing reattributed to Eternal Hunger, Blood Hunt kept as the speed tool keyed to the 50% threshold, and the pillar named as terrain that blocks both of your dashes.
sources: Trundle kit E 'terrain' flag and text

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate's spike was written without its duration or cooldown.
audit.why: It steals health, armour and MR immediately and doubles the amount over 4 seconds, on 120s at rank 1 — so the whole level-6 stage is about whether that 4-second window is running when you commit a 110s ultimate.
audit.corrected: 4-second doubling and the 120s cooldown written into the mid text.
sources: Trundle kit R text and cd 120/100/80

audit.why: Both layers already agree and match the already-audited trundle__warwick mirror: Trundle from level 1 through first item, two-plus items to Skill. Left untouched.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp shreds armor, heals, and grants attack speed, giving him the level-1 edge.
edits.after: Chomp saps your attack damage, slows, and resets his auto, giving him the level-1 edge.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp (Q) shreds your armor and heals him off every auto, so trading straight up early feeds his sustain; poke with Q Jaws and reset rather than sitting in his bite range.
edits.after: Chomp (Q) saps your attack damage every 3.5s and Frozen Domain (W) amplifies all his healing, so a stand-still trade in his zone feeds him; bite, then step off the domain.

edits.before: With Blood Hunt lifesteal and a completed bruiser item you finally out-heal his Chomp in extended fights; look for a below-50% enemy to trigger W's move-speed and lock him with R.
edits.after: With a completed bruiser item and Eternal Hunger you finally out-heal his Chomp in long fights; look for a below-50% Trundle to trigger Blood Hunt's speed and lock him with R.

edits.before: Once your first bruiser item and Blood Hunt lifesteal land you out-sustain his Chomp and win extended fights; Trundle is a lane bully who fades while Warwick becomes an unkillable hunter that locks and drags low targets down.
edits.after: Once your first bruiser item lands, Eternal Hunger and lifesteal out-sustain his Chomp and you win extended fights; Trundle is a lane bully who fades while Warwick becomes an unkillable hunter that drags low targets down.

edits.before: Trundle owns the first levels: his Chomp shreds your armor, heals him, and gives him attack speed, so a level-1 or level-3 brawl over his Contaminate zone goes his way. Farm with Q Jaws, dodge sitting still in his bite range, and don't int a trade just because you have Eternal Hunger healing.
edits.after: Trundle owns the first levels: Chomp saps your attack damage, slows you, and resets his auto, so a level-1 brawl inside Frozen Domain — where his healing is amplified — goes his way. Farm with Jaws of the Beast, stay out of his 300-range bite, and don't int a trade just because Eternal Hunger is healing you.

edits.before: By 3-5 it's even skill: your Q sustain and lane presence hold, but his Subjugate at 6 swings a straight duel by stripping your resistances and max HP. Respect that window, ping your jungler, and only commit R when his ult is on cooldown.
edits.after: By 3-5 it's even skill: your Q sustain holds, but Subjugate at 6 strips your health and resistances and doubles the theft over 4 seconds. Respect that 120s window, and remember Pillar of Ice is real terrain — it can block your leap.

edits.before: Short bites with Chomp to steal your armor and heal
edits.after: Short bites with Chomp to sap your attack damage

edits.before: Using Pillar (E) to slow you and kite your dash
edits.after: Pillar (E): terrain that blocks your Q and R dashes

notes: Chomp was wrong in three fields — it saps attack damage and resets his auto; it does not shred armour and does not heal him. His healing is King's Tribute (P) off dying units, amplified inside Frozen Domain (W). 'Contaminate' is not an ability in this kit and has been removed. 'Blood Hunt lifesteal' was the same passive/W swap the mirror found: Blood Hunt is speed keyed to the 50% threshold, Eternal Hunger is the heal. Level chart already agrees with the mirror and was left alone.
